items.text: Read the amenities section of the listing form and how amenities are saved
Check whether the project already has a recommended amenities list to reuse
Build the checklist with checked items plus an Add New option that rejects duplicates
Wire the selected list into the save payload and the edit-load path
Add the English and Swahili wording
Check it in the browser at desktop and phone width
Run lint and build, then commit and push
